newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore's Lee to visit Indonesia.
newsitem.headline: Singapore's Lee to visit Indonesia.

text.p: Singapore elder statesman Lee Kuan Yew will start a four-day visit to Indonesia from Tuesday, the Singapore government said in a statement on Monday.
It said Lee, prime minister from 1959 to 1990, would visit Jakarta from June 17 to 21 to attend a meeting of the JP Morgan International Council,, of which he is a member.
Lee, now Senior Minister in the cabinet, would also pay a courtesy call on President Suharto, the statement said.
